summary: Draganfly Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing the closing of a US$10 million registered direct offering of 1,869,159 common shares at US$5.35 per share, plus placement agent warrants, on September 29, 2026. Jett Capital Advisors and Northland Capital Markets acted as joint-lead placement agents. Proceeds fund advanced strategic capabilities and general working capital. Shares were sold in the United States only under an effective Form F-10 shelf and Canadian base shelf prospectus. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and use of proceeds.
